caption: 🧱 Lesson of the day: Support and resistance. Support is an area where falling price has often paused as buyers stepped in, and resistance is where rising price has often paused as sellers appeared. Treat them as zones, not exact lines. Example only: if price bounced twice near 100, mark a small area around 100 and watch how candles react when price returns. A level can break, so wait for a clear reaction before you act. Always know where your idea is wrong and place your stop loss there. Educational content, not financial advice. Trading is high risk.
